title: Fuobe Soul HEX · palettes
description: Generated by scripts/eval/gen-cases.mjs from the research files; edit the generator, not this file. A palette on Fuobe Soul, as the composer's Color signature sends it: the colours in the prompt on both engines, and on the open engine the palette lock after it (oss-palette-image, POST /api/palettes/lock: on by default for Fuobe Soul). Against the same words on today's base, Z-Image Turbo · Palette (the open engine's palette model before the Originals) and Fuobe Soul without the palette. The palette metric scores how closely each picture keeps to the colours (mean ΔE to the nearest one, and how many of them it uses). The palettes are Fuobe's own.
